services.desc: Opening reception for artists Tony Bedolla, Lenin Delsol, Stuart Fullerton, Mary Qian and Iona Ellsworth from The Palette and Chisel art club. Held in the Vanderpoel Art Gallery Ridge Park Fieldhouse 9625 S. Longwood Drive, Chicago The Palette & Chisel began in 1895, when students from the Art Institute came together to augment their formal studies. Today, the Palette is a thriving art community of students, members, and teachers who focus on realist painting and drawing, primarily working from life. They offer dozens of classes for all levels and have open studios for artists to hone their craft. They host exhibitions with art for sale, as well as social gatherings and lectures. Artists
